items.english: He never looked her way, his mind elsewhere, for rare guests were to come that day, and from early bed Zenpei was astir with preparations: sweep the garden, bring out the cushions, the hand brazier with its ginboya fittings, the Ikkan well bucket tobacco tray, in the alcove his boast, a Tanyu, the set of three scrolls of the Three Evenings poems for all to look at, the flower vase by Soho, mark but the signature, holding the autumn brocade of hill and field, and, with its heart at Tsukushi Bay, on the makie tray of plovers over waves, the stacked incense box in kintame lacquer said to be of Kamakura, set beside the kinuta celadon censer, and in the grip of the silver leaf tongs the brushwood boat parting the mist, its destination known only at the end of the smoke, enough to make one nod and nod again in the heart; to one side, on the rosewood stand inlaid with enamel, the silver hawk figure set out, let that too be counted among the talk, and the gold screen in full color, Korin birds and flowers wrought in relief with all his art; a splendid room, blue mats with Korai edging on which a jewel might be laid without shame, looking out before on the full wabi of the tea garden, a delight for shifting eyes, here is where worth is to be weighed, and, more pleased than any guest to come, his face streaked sideways with soot, the master alone looked round on every side, crying superb.
notes: Kept the reception list vessel by vessel as in the Japanese, including Tanyu, Soho, makie, kintame, kinuta celadon, Korin and Korai edging, without summarizing. Ginboya fitting, the Three Evenings scrolls, and the description of the leaf tongs with brushwood boat and smoke were kept literal though the exact workshop or picture reference is uncertain. Soot smudge kept as the sign of the pleased host inspecting his own display.

items.english: "Toyo, wipe the go stones clean. Risuke, now, the hand basin, the thread patterned bowls are in the storehouse. The Nankin blue and white clam dishes, shall it be these or shall it be those, Mitsuyo, where is Mitsuyo, Mitsuyo, Mitsuyo." Called out thus, Mitsuyo came forward against her will, and Zenpei rose to outdo himself. "Now today, you see, with Okumura-sama and other important guests, you must come out and pour for us. Change your clothes now and be quick to get ready," he ordered her.
notes: Kept the repeated calling of Mitsuyo and the run of orders as bustle. Thread patterned bowls, hand basin and Nankin clam dishes kept literal; storehouse follows kura. Kept Okumura-sama to hold the rank climbing.

data.say: Drafted the reception display and the summons of Mitsuyo.
